agent.description: Logical agent identity for sidecar correlation (X-DefenseClaw-Agent-Id)

id.description: Stable logical agent id; overrides the persisted extension id when set

sidecarPort.description: Separate-user layout: port of the DefenseClaw gateway API (gateway.api_port). Written by an administrator from the block defenseclaw setup prints.

awsHttp1Shim.description: Amazon Bedrock: pi-ai uses HTTP/2 by default, which bypasses the guardrail proxy. When enabled, sets AWS_BEDROCK_FORCE_HTTP1=1 (pi-ai) and applies a Smithy fallback patch. auto = on only if OpenClaw model config references Bedrock; on = always; off = never.

sidecarHost.description: Separate-user layout: loopback host of the DefenseClaw gateway (gateway.host).

guardrailPort.description: Separate-user layout: port of the DefenseClaw guardrail proxy (guardrail.port).

tokenFile.description: Separate-user layout: absolute path of the plugin credential the DefenseClaw gateway publishes (connectors.openclaw.plugin_token_file). Without it the plugin reads its credential and settings from the DefenseClaw data folder of its own account.

hookMode.description: Written by defenseclaw setup from connectors.openclaw.hooks.mode and the OpenClaw version: hybrid = native plugin hooks plus the guardrail proxy, native = native plugin hooks only (Windows). Absent = the guardrail proxy with before_tool_call (OpenClaw before 2026.8.35).

promptGate.description: Written by defenseclaw setup from connectors.openclaw.hooks.prompt_gate: check every user prompt in before_agent_run. Always on in native mode.
